# element-fullscreen

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: The browser's element fullscreen, only where it exists: fullscreenSupport(doc?) answers unsupported (an iPhone has no element fullscreen; a frame without allowfullscreen may not use it) or supported with request(el) — so a caller must branch before it can ask — and useFullscreenSupport() reads it while rendering, for a control that is not offered where the browser cannot do it. Its lint rule (no-raw-request-fullscreen) sends every other .requestFullscreen() call here.
- Web:
  - Uses: `primitives/dom/render-mode.useBrowserValue`
  - Exports (types): `FullscreenSupport`
  - Exports (values):
    - `fullscreenSupport`
    - `useFullscreenSupport`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `apps/keyboard-party/party`
    - `apps/prototypes/present`
    - `fullscreen`
    - `media/player`
    - `primitives/overlay/image-viewer`
- Exemptions:
  - Exempts itself from: `element-fullscreen/no-raw-request-fullscreen` — `web/internal/fullscreen-support.ts` (sanctioned)
  - Exempted by: `primitives/dom/element-fullscreen` (0 debt)
